# Update Managementsvg image

## Purpose and Scopesvg image

Update Management in Contexter provides a patch-based version control system for context files. This system enables incremental updates to context files by generating differential patches between versions and applying those changes to existing contexts. The update system supports both Markdown and HTML context formats and offers multiple patch generation strategies optimized for different use cases.

This page covers the patch generation and application mechanisms, patch file formats, and the different update strategies available. For details on individual update commands, see sections [5.3](/ray0404/Contexter/5.3-update-commands), [5.3.1](/ray0404/Contexter/5.3.1-updatecontext), [5.3.2](/ray0404/Contexter/5.3.2-updater), [5.3.3](/ray0404/Contexter/5.3.3-smartupdate), [5.3.4](/ray0404/Contexter/5.3.4-updatecontexthtml), and [5.3.5](/ray0404/Contexter/5.3.5-updaterhtml). For information about context file formats themselves, see [3.1](/ray0404/Contexter/3.1-context-files), [7.1](/ray0404/Contexter/7.1-markdown-context-format), and [7.2](/ray0404/Contexter/7.2-html-context-format).

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md20-36](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L20-L36)

---

## The Patch-Based Systemsvg image

Contexter's update system operates on the principle of differential updates: comparing two versions of a context file (or source directories) to generate a patch file that encodes only the changes between them. This patch can then be applied to a target context file to update it incrementally without rebuilding from scratch.

### Core Componentssvg image

The update system consists of five primary commands organized into generation and application phases:

| Command | Module | Function | Format |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `updatecontext` | `update_context.py` | Generates patches using standard diff | Markdown |
| `smartupdate` | `smart_update.py` | Generates patches using rsync algorithm | Markdown |
| `updater` | `updater.py` | Applies patches to context files | Markdown |
| `updatecontexthtml` | `update_context_html.py` | Generates patches from HTML contexts | HTML |
| `updaterhtml` | `updater_html.py` | Applies patches to HTML contexts | HTML |

### System Architecturesvg image

**Patch Generation Flow:** The system accepts two input versions (either context files or directories) and produces a patch file encoding their differences using the Python `patch` library.

**Patch Application Flow:** The `parse_patch_file()` function auto-detects the patch format and parses it into patch objects, which are then applied to a target context file to produce an updated version.

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md27-33](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L27-L33) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py40-52](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L40-L52) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py131-176](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L131-L176)

---

## Patch Generation Strategiessvg image

Contexter offers three distinct strategies for generating patches, each optimized for different scenarios.

### Standard Diff-Based Updatessvg image

#### Markdown: `updatecontext`svg image

The `updatecontext` command implements traditional unified diff generation for Markdown context files. It compares two `.md` context files line-by-line and generates a patch file in Markdown format.

**Implementation:** Module `update_context.py` (entry point at [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py43](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L43-L43))

**Algorithm:** Standard text-based diff using the `patch` library to create unified diffs for each changed file section within the context file.

**Use Cases:**

- Small to medium projects with moderate changes
- When universal diff compatibility is required
- When patch files need to be human-readable for review

#### HTML: `updatecontexthtml`svg image

The `updatecontexthtml` command provides equivalent functionality for HTML context files, generating patches by comparing two `.html` context files.

**Implementation:** Module `update_context_html.py` (entry point at [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py51](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L51-L51))

**Output:** Can generate either Markdown or HTML formatted patch files, specified via command-line arguments.

### Smart Updates (Recommended)svg image

#### `smartupdate`svg image

The `smartupdate` command is the **recommended** approach for patch generation, using the rsync delta-encoding algorithm for high-efficiency updates.

**Implementation:** Module `smart_update.py` (entry point at [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py45](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L45-L45))

**Algorithm:** Leverages rsync's rolling checksum algorithm to detect and encode only the changed blocks, resulting in smaller patch files and faster generation times.

**Key Advantages:**

- **Performance:** Significantly faster for large projects or many changes
- **Efficiency:** Smaller patch file sizes due to block-level differencing
- **Flexibility:** Can operate directly on directories, not just context files
- **Scalability:** Maintains performance with increasing project complexity

**Comparison Table:**

| Feature | `updatecontext` | `smartupdate` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Algorithm | Line-based unified diff | Block-based rsync delta |
| Performance | Moderate | High |
| Patch Size | Larger | Smaller |
| Input Types | Context files only | Context files or directories |
| Compatibility | Universal | Python `patch` library |
| Recommended | Standard usage | High-performance scenarios |

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md29](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L29-L29) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py43-45](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L43-L45)

## Patch File Formatssvg image

Contexter patches are stored as structured text files that encode file-level diffs. The system supports two patch formats corresponding to the two context file formats.

### Markdown Patch Formatsvg image

Markdown patches follow a structured format with clear delimiters:

[unified diff content]

```px-2
--- DIFF FOR: another/file.js ---
```

[unified diff content]

**Structure:**

- Each file's patch is preceded by a header: `--- DIFF FOR: <filepath> ---`
- The diff content is enclosed in triple-backtick code blocks
- Multiple file patches are concatenated in sequence

**Parsing:** The `_parse_md_patch()` function ([![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py139-161](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L139-L161)) handles Markdown patch parsing:

The parser:

1. Scans for the diff header pattern ([![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py144](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L144-L144))
2. Accumulates diff lines until the closing code fence ([![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py154-156](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L154-L156))
3. Converts accumulated text to patch objects using `patch.fromstring()` ([![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py150](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L150-L150))

### HTML Patch Formatsvg image

HTML patches use structured div containers for organization:

**Structure:**

- Each file's patch is contained in a `<div class="diff-container">` element
- The file path is stored in the `data-path` attribute
- Diff content is within a `<pre>` tag for formatting preservation

**Parsing:** The `_parse_html_patch()` function ([![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py163-176](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L163-L176)) uses BeautifulSoup for HTML parsing:

The parser:

1. Finds all `diff-container` elements ([![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py171](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L171-L171))
2. Extracts the `data-path` attribute and `<pre>` content ([![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py172-173](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L172-L173))
3. Converts to patch objects ([![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py175](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L175-L175))

### Auto-Detection and Cross-Format Applicationsvg image

The `parse_patch_file()` function ([![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py131-137](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L131-L137)) provides automatic format detection:

**Cross-Format Support:** Patches can be applied across formats, enabling workflows such as:

- Generate Markdown patch from HTML contexts (`updatecontexthtml` with MD output)
- Apply HTML-formatted patches to Markdown contexts
- Mix patch formats in version control workflows

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py131-176](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L131-L176)

---

## Patch Applicationsvg image

### The `updater` Commandsvg image

The `updater` command applies Markdown-formatted patches to Markdown context files.

**Implementation:** Module `updater.py` (entry point at [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py44](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L44-L44))

**Process:**

1. Parse the input patch file using `parse_patch_file()`
2. Parse the target context file to extract file contents
3. Apply each file-level patch to the corresponding content
4. Rebuild the updated context file with modified contents

**Input:**

- A patch file (`.md` format by default)
- A target context file (`.md`)

**Output:** An updated context file with changes applied

### The `updaterhtml` Commandsvg image

The `updaterhtml` command provides equivalent functionality for HTML context files.

**Implementation:** Module `updater_html.py` (entry point at [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py52](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L52-L52))

**Format Support:** Can apply both Markdown and HTML formatted patches to HTML context files, demonstrating the cross-format capability of the patch system.

### Application Workflow Diagramsvg image

**Error Handling:** The patch application process handles:

- Missing target files (adds new files)
- Patch conflicts (reports to user)
- Binary file patches (skipped with warning)

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py44-52](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L44-L52) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py131-137](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L131-L137)

---

## Update Workflowssvg image

### Incremental Development Workflowsvg image

**Use Case:** Maintaining synchronized context files across multiple locations or team members without transmitting entire context files.

**Workflow Steps:**

1. Generate baseline context with `buildcontext`
2. After development changes, generate new context version
3. Use `smartupdate` to create patch between versions
4. Distribute patch file (much smaller than full context)
5. Recipients apply patch with `updater` to update their local contexts

### Version Control Integrationsvg image

**Scenario:** Tracking project evolution in a repository

| Version | Context File | Patch File | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| v1.0.0 | `project_v1.md` | — | Initial release |
| v1.1.0 | `project_v1_1.md` | `v1.0_to_v1.1.patch` | Feature additions |
| v1.2.0 | `project_v1_2.md` | `v1.1_to_v1.2.patch` | Bug fixes |
| v2.0.0 | `project_v2.md` | `v1.2_to_v2.0.patch` | Major refactor |

**Advantages:**

- **Audit Trail:** Patches provide reviewable change history
- **Rollback:** Reverse patches enable version rollback
- **Branching:** Different patch sequences can represent feature branches
- **Distribution:** Patches are significantly smaller than full contexts

### AI Iteration Workflowsvg image

**Scenario:** Iterative development with AI assistance

**Advantages:**

- Review AI changes as discrete patches before applying
- Selectively apply AI suggestions
- Maintain original context while experimenting
- Track which AI suggestions were incorporated

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md27-29](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L27-L29)

---

## Dependencies and Implementationsvg image

The update system relies on the following key dependencies specified in [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)pyproject.toml23-29](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/pyproject.toml#L23-L29):

| Library | Purpose | Usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `patch` | Unified diff generation and application | Core patching functionality |
| `markdown` | Markdown parsing | Context file processing |
| `beautifulsoup4` | HTML parsing | HTML patch parsing |

**Integration Point:** All patch parsing functionality is centralized in `contexter_utils.py` ([![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py131-176](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L131-L176)), providing a shared implementation used by both generation and application commands. This centralization ensures consistent patch format handling across all commands.

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)pyproject.toml23-29](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/pyproject.toml#L23-L29) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py11](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L11-L11)
